parole.significato: A cafe, restaurant or bar in Alsace that specialises in beer.
parole.testo: From Alsatian Alemannic German Bierstub f (possibly via French bierstub), cognate to German Bierstube.

parole.significato: A cafe, restaurant or bar in Alsace that specialises in wine.
parole.testo: From Alsatian Alemannic German Winstub f (possibly via French winstub), cognate to German Weinstube.
